generatedFrom: vendor MaxDps v11.3.49 (Cooldowns.lua, SpellData.lua) + docs/research/registry-research.json (live 12.1 research, 2026-09-28)
notes: Curated policy layer merged over Knowledge/vendor-abilities.json by AbilityCatalog.
Only fields that differ from the category default are present. Values marked
source=vendor-only or note=unverified are vendor-table entries whose behaviour could
not be cross-checked against a second current source; they keep conservative defaults.
Cooldown/duration values are approximate sequencing hints, not exact game timers.
v2.6 ability intelligence: status/automation are derived from provenance unless stated;
staging file (registry-research.json). Absent fields are derived, never invented.
v2.7 coverage registry: ownership/completeness/delegation/manualReason and the patch
sourceConfidence/liveVerified) are derived by AbilityCatalog unless curated here.
Every MaxDps-owned entry must carry a delegation reason and every manual entry a
manual reason; the audit (--ability-audit) fails otherwise. liveVerified stays false
until a live-client behavior pass records it - offline evidence is never live proof.
